# Provider search / fetch — execution and recovery
Semantic pattern: **unstructured input → structured artifact** + recovery -> visual types: **data flow** + **flowchart** * verified at HEAD `ac770f7`
Controller SOURCE_SEARCH / SOURCE_FETCH ProviderAdapter provider-scoped, spec-driven Rate limiter ProviderRateLimiter HTTP transport untrusted responses Hazard evaluation evaluate_hazards → HazardVerdict Outcome record NEW / IDENTICAL / DIVERGENT Artifacts + provenance edges SourceRetracted retraction marker only (HZ-02) NEW: artifact + edges REMOVED_OR_RETRACTED same transaction as the record NEW-only; NOT_OA never emits RECOVERY Task RUNNING lease held (generation fenced) crash / NO_SIGNAL lease goes stale; horizon refresh exits recovery reclaims generation++ — new owner outcome persisted? SourceOutcomeRepository lookup IDENTICAL → reuse no duplicate artifacts/events re-execute (fenced) NO_SIGNAL → FAILED → requeue YES NO stale A write after B reclaims -> rejected (binding guard before the fence) At-most-one active lease + at-least-once completion + idempotent/binding-protected persistence * recovery band = flowchart detail of the main data flow (overview + detail split)
